patches.name: Debug Kiki voice failures
patches.description: Logs Kiki voice ASR/auth/network failure details to logcat for diagnosing guest-mode voice requests.

patches.name: Disable telemetry and ad SDKs
patches.description: Stops the ad networks and analytics, attribution, crash reporting and session tracking SDKs from starting, and blocks every connection that reading, comments and signing in do not need. Also lets Wattpad run with GrapheneOS's dynamic code loading via memory blocked.

patches.name: Hide premium promos
patches.description: Hides premium upsell buttons and banners, including the "No ads" button at the end of a part, and prevents the subscription paywall from being shown.

patches.name: Hide reader ads
patches.description: Hides banner and interstitial ads displayed while reading stories and on story details, the empty sticky banner slot over the bottom of the page, the ad rows between comments, and the ad skips promo row.

patches.name: Keep reader size steady
patches.description: Keeps the reader the same size when the system bars appear or hide, so paging mode does not lay out the whole part again when the reading menu opens or the app is resumed.

patches.name: Open YouTube in default app
patches.description: Opens YouTube links with Android's default app instead of forcing the stock YouTube package.

patches.name: Preload reader pages
patches.description: Lays out the next pages in paging mode before they are reached, so turning a page does not show a loading page.

patches.name: Skip Zalo login
patches.description: Uses Kiki Auto's guest authentication fallback instead of requiring Zalo login before app use.

patches.name: Unlimited offline stories
patches.description: Removes the limit on the number of stories that can be saved for offline reading.

patches.name: Unlock theme colours
patches.description: Unlocks all theme colours in the Customize theme screen without a premium subscription.

patches.name: Use Android share sheet
patches.description: Shares stories, parts, quotes and profiles through Android's share sheet instead of Wattpad's own share grid, without the tracking parameters and username Wattpad adds to shared links.
